_comment: Ratchet baseline for module-level `static` declarations in FFI bridges that are NOT on the explicit allowlist in scripts/check-no-bridge-globals.sh. The allowlist covers RUNTIME, HANDLE_COUNT, SHARED_DHT_CLIENT, INSTANCE_ID_COUNTER, and `std::sync::Once` init guards. Anything else is counted here. The gate fails when the count goes UP — new statics must move onto the per-bridge instance or extend the allowlist with justification.
_updated: 2026-04-19 (Phase 4 PR 4 façade deletion — ratchet drops to zero)
_context: Phase 4 PR 4 (#1549) deleted `DEFAULT_BRIDGE_INSTANCE` along with every free-function façade forwarder, and the EMPTY_* fallback registries that existed to cover the uninitialised-default-instance case. Every per-identity singleton now lives on a per-bridge instance (PyBridgeInstance / NapiBridgeInstance / UniffiBridgeInstance). The ratchet now floors at zero in every bridge — any new module-level static is a regression.
